name: Zakon o gradnji - Croatian Building Act
regulator: Ministarstvo prostornoga uređenja, graditeljstva i državne imovine (Ministry of Physical Planning, Construction and State Assets)
description: Reference document for the Zakon o gradnji, which sets the participants in construction (investitor, projektant, izvođač, nadzorni inženjer), the design documentation a building permit (građevinska dozvola) rests on, the obligation to keep a construction log (građevni dnevnik) on site and the use permit (uporabna dozvola) that closes a project. Structural design follows the HRN EN Eurocodes. The act is procedural and does not set prices; what the pack checks is that the priced bill that accompanies the design is complete and reconciles.
review_status: Regulatory references are drawn from public sources and are pending review by a Croatian chartered engineer before they are relied on. The consolidated text in force must be confirmed against Narodne novine.
